methodology: Articles sourced from Virginia-specific RSS feeds and Google News RSS, filtered for AI/technology/workforce relevance, then assessed by Claude against the scenario framework. Each article is tagged with the region it most affects and the scenario it signals toward.

signals.title: Roanoke College launches WorkAI Lab to prepare leaders for new era of technology - Roanoke College
signals.signal_reading: Roanoke College's WorkAI Lab represents distributed capacity-building outside metro hubs, signaling potential for deep AI fluency development in non-NoVA regions through institutional education infrastructure.

signals.title: Norfolk native brings free AI workshops to Hampton Roads to close the technology gap - WTKR
signals.signal_reading: Free community AI workshops in Hampton Roads signal grassroots distributed learning and peer-to-peer skill transfer, directly addressing the technology gap through accessible deep learning rather than platform dependency.

signals.title: RFK Jr., during Monday trip to Danville, says AI will transform rural healthcare
signals.signal_reading: Promise of AI transforming rural healthcare in Danville suggests shallow, platform-delivered solutions for underserved regions—technology adoption without local capability development, reinforcing vendor dependency in rural areas.

signals.title: Fairfax Co. students launch AI tool to summarize school board meetings
signals.signal_reading: Fairfax students building custom AI tools demonstrates deep technical capability concentrated in NoVA's resource-rich educational environment, widening the gap between metro youth opportunities and rural access to hands-on AI development.

signals.title: U.Va. Health expands AI use across patient care, research and education - The Cavalier Daily
signals.signal_reading: UVA Health's comprehensive AI integration across care, research, and education concentrates advanced capability in elite institutional settings, creating deep expertise islands rather than distributable knowledge across Virginia's healthcare system.
